messages:
mike_p: Customer hit garbled output after an auth-refresh short disconnect. Seems like resumed fragments and inflight fragments interleaved.
mike_p: Repro (flaky): start stream -> force auth refresh (client reconnect) -> resume token present -> final text has earlier fragment after newer one.
anya: Which SDK and transport?
mike_p: node sample-app v0.11.2 using resume_token header. Wire snippet:
```
[15:22:10.001Z] evt id=1200 part=1 data=\"Howeve\"
[15:22:10.002Z] connection: reset
[15:22:10.003Z] reconnect resume=rt_77
[15:22:10.004Z] evt id=1201 part=1 data=\"r, the\"
[15:22:10.005Z] replay id=1200 part=2 data=\"r, the\"
```
mike_p: Client emitted: "Howeverr, ther, the" -> duplication + order wrong.
proxy-bot: Created ticket PROXY-4201 to investigate async tail flush + resume interleave.
sdk-lee: Short-term SDK mitigation: add small reassembly buffer keyed by (id,part) and hold emission on reconnect for up to 120ms or until all parts seen. Will submit micro-PR.
qa-ron: Add a flaky integration test that simulates TCP flaps and reorder delivery, make timeout configurable.
anya: Long-term: runtime should add stable ordering headers (X-Chunk-Seq, X-Chunk-Part) and avoid flushing buffered outbound fragments after a reconnect starts. Also consider adding X-Resume-Source to help dedupe across proxy failover.
mike_p: I'll coordinate canary test after SDK patch lands. If it fixes the visible issue we'll ship SDK fix and follow up with runtime feature-flag rollout. :thumbsup:
sdk-lee: PR: https://git.internal/r/node-sdk/623 (buffer-on-resume + flaky test harness)."
